<!-- pr-reviewer: d12a3bfaa744221df26bfc153afcb0f76611fb0c -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is the first review of this head. It found no blocker.

This PR changes guide text only (`site/content/guide/` and one `docs/decisions/` file). It does not change posted G-code, a check, the simulation or geometry. It is not a safety-tier review. It changes no `crates/ui` code, thus screenshots are not necessary.

## What looks good

- Each UI label in the new text is a string in the source:
  - `Arc turns at row ends` and `Arc radius = half the row spacing` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs:75`).
  - `Arc turns at corners` (`mill2d_page.rs:179`) and `Arc radius = tool radius` (`kind_editors.rs:152`).
  - `Arc turns at row ends` for Slot (`mill2d_more_page.rs:85`).
  - `Side`, `Run-out clearance`, `Freed piece captured`, `Both pieces clamped through all passes` and `Stock centered in installed XY travel` (`wire_page.rs:198-237`).
  - `Start hole stated` (`start_exit_rows.rs:82`) and `Separation cut length (mm)` (`assets/posts/agie-native.cps:10`).
- The arc turn limits agree with the code. The minimum radius is 0.01 mm (`MIN_BLEND_RADIUS`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/blend.rs:52`). The maximum is the tool radius (`fillet_tally.rs:126`, `blend.rs:98`). A Face with a smaller radius uses two quarter arcs and a straight step (`blend.rs:82-92`). A slot of one row has no turn (`slot_turns.rs:47`). Contour corners toward the part stay sharp and the notes name them (`contour_params.rs:122-126`).
- The wire EDM numbers agree with the code and with `docs/user-guide/agie-wire-edm.md`:
  - The QN2 table (15, 20, 40, 80 mm) and the 0.4 mm margin.
  - The 0.002 mm corner reach (`crates/post/src/agie/contour.rs:294`).
  - The 3.6 mm run-out limit and the 4 mm tails (`agie_profile.rs:136`, `cutoff.rs:6`).
  - The 350 x 250 mm span (`cutoff.rs:8`).
  - The circle radius of 6 to 15 mm (`round_profile.rs:107`).
  - The group name of seven characters (`group.rs:68`).
  - The CCB035 values, with Ra, Te and Tkm in µm (`agie_setup/quality.rs:15,51`), and the technology name (`quality.rs:23`).
- The Posting page now uses the neutral post name. Its link target `#native-wire-edm-job-files` agrees with the new heading in `operations-edm.md`.
- The decision file has the `## #N - <title>` heading and says what was dropped.
- The body has `Changelog: none`, a "Goldens moved" section and `Refs #3909`. `Refs` is correct: the issue #3909 has more open items.
- No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`) changed. No process file changed.

## Results, merged with main

All steps ran locally. `upstream/main` is `f19ca562b`. The PR head is a direct child of that commit, thus the trial merge is the PR head.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` | "nothing in crates/ changed: no tests to run" (0 steps) |
| `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests` on the PR head | 104 tests: 95 pass, 1 failure, 8 errors |
| The same command on bare `upstream/main` (`f19ca562b`) | 104 tests: 95 pass, the same 1 failure, the same 8 errors |
| `zola --root site build` | not run: this host refused the command. The author reports a pass (50 pages, 10 sections). I checked the one new internal link and its anchor by hand |
| `git diff --check` | clean |
| Clippy, Cargo tests, example catalog, heavy lanes | not applicable: no file in `crates/`, `assets/posts/` or `examples/` changed |

The red site tests are the same on the PR head and on bare `upstream/main`. This PR does not cause them:

- `test_first_4axis_part` and `test_first_continuous_4axis_part`, label `New tool…` (2 errors): the guides refer to the removed `tool_library.rs` path. The PR body names these.
- `test_guide_icons.test_component_static_icons_and_license_match_app` (1 failure): the site license notice and the app license notice are different. The PR body names this.
- `test_search_query` (6 errors): `node` is not installed on this review host. This is a condition of the host.

No issue tracks the first two items by name. Issue #3764 ("Run the site tests before a cut") is related.

Extra suites run: none. The diff changes no file under `testdata/`, no fixture or golden directory and no import code.

Mutations: not applicable (guide text only).

Heavy lanes: not reached by this diff. No heavy record is necessary.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `site/content/guide/operations/operations-edm.md` (section "Native wire EDM job files"): the decision file says that the full control procedure stays in `docs/user-guide/agie-wire-edm.md`. The site page does not link to that file. A link can help an operator to find the import steps.
2. `operations-edm.md` (section "Native wire EDM job files"): the repository guide says that the post refuses a machine profile with a stated X or Y travel limit. The site page does not say this. One sentence can prevent an unexpected refusal.

## Follow-ups (file after merge)

- Site tests: the two first-part guides refer to the removed `tool_library.rs` path for `New tool…`, and the site license notice differs from `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`. Both are red on `upstream/main`. Suggested priority: `P7` (related: #3764).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Ready for merge from the merge loop: collaborator review d12a3bf7 at head d12a3bfaa744221df26bfc153afcb0f76611fb0c.
